LanguageData.RimForex_Loan2Desc: Community mutual aid: low interest, high breeding. Membership requirements are loose, repayment requirements are loose, and growth in member count is arranged separately. Assimilation is far more efficient than repayment.

LanguageData.RimForex_GuideIntro:
Welcome to the Interstellar FX Terminal.

Voted best trading experience in the galaxy for 87 consecutive quarters (data collected by us).

Trading takes three steps: pick a currency, add leverage, press the button.
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideLong:
Going long means buying. Bet it rises and you keep the difference; bet wrong and you lose your margin.

When should you buy? Our official answers:
· There is news it will rise. Buy.
· No news, but it has fallen for a long time. Buy. That is called bottom-fishing.
· It is already surging. Buy. That is called momentum.

If you want to buy, you will always find a reason. That is why our users love us.
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideShort:
The other way round: sell first, buy back after it falls, keep the difference.

· News says it will fall. Sell.
· They just lost a war or their economy collapsed. Sell.
· It has fallen for a long time. Sell, the trend continues.

One note: a short caps at 100% profit, but losses have no ceiling. We reserve the right to collect.
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideLiquidation:
Leverage magnifies gains and losses. They come as a package.

· At 45% margin left, we pause the game and warn you. That is our service.
· At 30%, we close the position for you. That is a margin call.
· If a gap is brutal enough that losses exceed your margin, the balance goes negative. That is a blow-up.

After a blow-up you cannot open positions or withdraw. Deposit silver to clear it.
Our collections department is available 24 hours and has no feelings.
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideCandle:
Each candle records four prices over a period: open, high, low, close.

· Body: the distance from open to close. Green up, red down.
· Wicks: the thin lines above and below, the high and low reached.

Long wicks mean price pushed up and got pushed back. Someone is fighting. Who wins is unclear.

Candles report the past. They do not promise the future. Platforms that promise the future are a different kind of platform.
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideProfit:
Leverage up! Go all in! Bet on the rise!

Post 100 silver as margin at 100x and your notional is 10,000 silver. A 1% move earns you 100 silver, double your money. 3% and you have tripled it.

Our backend data shows the phrase our users say most is "one more trade and I'm even".

(Veterans tell you to use low leverage and go slow. That is the veteran way. You are a beginner. You have plenty of time to lose.)
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideLoan:
With the terminal selected, the "Official lending service" gizmo offers four lenders with different rates and terms.

Borrowed silver is debt, not income. If it is not cleared by the term, it is taken from your balance at once, which can push it negative.

We wish you a pleasant borrowing experience.
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideGlossary:
Margin: the silver you post.
Notional: margin times leverage.
Spread: the gap between buy and sell, paid on open and close.
Fee: 0.02% per trade, minimum 2 silver.
Stop-out line: the price where a position is closed at 30% margin.
Margin call: being forcibly closed.
Blow-up: losses exceed margin, balance goes negative.
Lock-in: you must cross one quote before you can close.

LanguageData.RimForex_GuideHonestButton: (A veteran's advice: don't listen to them)
LanguageData.RimForex_GuideHonest:
That last part was written by our marketing department. Here is the human version.

1. Lower leverage survives longer. 1-5x rides out normal swings; 100x dies to one bad quote.
2. Do not churn. Every round trip pays spread and fees. Churning is a donation.
3. Watch the news. War and crash expectations beat staring at candles.
4. Positions cost overnight interest, loans cost loan interest. The longer you hold, the more you pay.
5. There is no sure-win strategy. Anyone who says there is, is trying to win your money.

(Put this away before the platform notices you read it.)

LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7RefuseTip: Refusing brings a mechanoid raid and freezes the account for one year: no new positions, no withdrawals.
LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7HostageShort: Not enough value selected, or nothing selected at all.
LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7Attack:
You went after their man. They sent mechanoids, and your account is frozen for {0} days - no positions, no withdrawals.
We wish you a pleasant week.
LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7Paid: Collections confirms receipt. The collector has left.
LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7Hostage: The debt was paid in people and the account is clear. We make no comment on the method.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgFrozen: Account frozen. {0} more day(s) before you can trade.
LanguageData.RimForex_TestDebtTip: Force the account negative and start collection immediately, skipping the two-day wait.
LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7CanClose: You can close this window and go raise the money. Select the terminal later and use the "Debt settlement" gizmo to reopen it.\n\nTime is not paused, and the collector will wait near your colony.
LanguageData.RimForex_Ev7GizmoDesc: Collections is still waiting for your answer.
LanguageData.RimForex_FrozenWarning: Account frozen: {0} day(s) left (no positions, no withdrawals)
LanguageData.RimForex_LoanFrozen: Account frozen. Borrowing unlocks 30 days into the freeze.
